select TAB_NUM tabNum, TAB_NAME tabName, TEMP_PATH tempPath, TEMP_NAME tempName, case when STATUS='E' then '有效' when STATUS='D' then '删除' else '待处理' end status from DIS_POI_TAB WHERE 1=1
and TAB_NUM like concat(concat('%',#{tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and TAB_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{tabName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and TEMP_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{tempName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
and STATUS like concat(concat('%',#{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
order by tabNum,IFNULL(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) desc
